changelog: 源头去AI化:受众状态转移大纲+卫生层+T1-T4语域锁死,防止PPT一眼AI味与四不像
summary: Removes AI-generated writing tells from presentation and content drafts by rewriting tone at the SOURCE - before prose freezes into a data model or HTML. Uses an Audience-State-Transfer outline method plus an always-on hygiene layer and four register tiers (T1 formal to T4 casual) that lock a single voice per deck to prevent mixed-register 'four-way monsters'.
